posts.title: TIL - How to Combine Audio and Video Without Re-encoding
posts.description: Recently I had some recordings where the audio and video were downloaded as separate files. I wanted to combine them into one MP4 without having to re-encode everything. You can do this with ffmpeg using -c copy 1 : snippet.sh ffmpeg -n -i video.mp4 -i audio.mp4 \ -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c copy combined.mp4 bash 2 lines "snippet.sh" 2L The -map 0:v:0 takes the first video stream from the first file

posts.title: TIL - How to Escape Single Quotes in Nix Indented Strings
posts.description: Recently I was moving my pi sessions to XDG directories and hit an issue putting a Bash script inside a Nix indented string. The script used read -r -d '' to read file paths separated by a null character. The Bash was valid, but the '' ended the surrounding Nix string, so this didn’t parse: snippet.nix pkgs . writeShellScript "list-files" '' while IFS= read -r -d '' file ; do printf '% s \ n' "$fi
